name: VCode
description: VCode is a multimodal coding benchmark that reframes multimodal understanding as code generation, requiring models to produce SVG code preserving symbolic meaning from images. It covers domains including general commonsense, professional disciplines, and visual-centric perception, and introduces a novel evaluation protocol CodeVQA to assess symbolic fidelity.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with emerging interest, but not yet widely adopted as a standard multimodal coding evaluation.
notes: Introduces a new benchmark with symbolic visual coding using SVG and a novel evaluation protocol CodeVQA.
